notes.title: New Challenges + Linux!
notes.content:
Insomnious finally got a content update!

Not much to say here besides 
[list]
[*] 2 New Challenges have been added to Challenge Mode
[*] 2 New Achievements related to said challenges
[*] Linux Support!
[/list]

[i]Why no MAC support?[/i]
I have no idea. Unity just won't let me build to MAC because of the version of steamworks I'm using for Insomnious. So MAC users still can't play Insomnious, sorry!

Happy 1 year of Insomnious!

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
just a few bug fixes including

- custom night and challenge nights being unplayable after exiting via the escape key
- the audio settings not saving correctly
- music randomly stopping when quitting a night via the escape key
